name: E-Web(15) Heavy Repeating Blaster
description: The E-Web(15) Heavy Repeating Blaster was manufactured by BlasTech Industries, and was a modified version of their standard E-Web heavy repeating blaster. Released the year after Palpatine's death, the E-Web(15) was a two-man weapon that could be "quick-mounted" on a tripod, allowing it to be set up and operational in under five minutes using the attached generator's "autoconfigure" setting.
